case_title: Anand Ramachandra Chougule v. Sidarai Laxman Chougala and Others
statutory_provisions: IPC s.302, s.34; IPC s.304 Part I/34
mitigating_circumstances: Spur of the moment, land dispute, mutual injuries
trial_court_outcome: Convicted all four accused under s. 302/34 IPC
high_court_outcome: Altered conviction to s. 304 Part I/34, acquitted two accused
neutral_facts: The accused and the victim were related and had a land dispute. A verbal duel followed by a scuffle occurred between the parties, resulting in injuries. The accused lodged an FIR regarding the incident, which was not investigated. The accused were admitted to a hospital for treatment of injuries sustained during the incident, but injury reports were not provided. The prosecution failed to explain why the FIR was not investigated and why the injury reports were not brought to court. The trial court convicted all four accused under Section 302/34 of the IPC, but the High Court altered the conviction to Section 304 Part I/34 and acquitted two accused due to the lack of premeditation and mutual injuries.
